title: Cover essential housing, food, and utilities
summary: Rent or mortgage (including required insurance), groceries, power, water, heat. These are non-negotiable.
detailsHtml:
Housing benchmark

Lenders historically capped front-end debt-to-income at 28% for mortgages (housing costs to gross income). For renters in high-cost areas, 30–35% is common but adds pressure on every other goal. Above 40% and most paths through this flowchart become difficult — addressing the housing decision often dominates everything below it.

Insurance requirements at this stage

Renters insurance ($15–25/month) covers your possessions and liability — often the cheapest dollar-for-dollar protection available. Homeowners insurance is typically required by the mortgage. Auto insurance is legally required in nearly every state if you drive.
